Copy / Listen hoạt động offline trên trình duyệt hỗ trợ.
30-second response practice

Nhìn tình huống → nói câu của bạn → xem gợi ý

Scenario 1TA / PMO / Developer / Manager

Say this — avoid an unintended meaning

Không sai ngữ pháp, nhưng nên chọn câu sát mục đích

Tình huốngƯu tiênKhông nên nói nếu không đúng ý
Chờ duyệt, vẫn có việc để làmIn the meantime, we can check the tests.For the time being, we can check the tests. (không nhấn đúng ý đang chờ)
Giữ config tạm thờiFor the time being, let's keep the current config.In the meantime, keep this forever. (mâu thuẫn về thời gian)
Chỉ có thể thửI can give it a try.I guarantee I can fix it. (hứa quá mức)
Xin logsCould you share the relevant logs and timestamps?Send all logs with passwords. (không an toàn)
Không nghe rõSorry, could you say that again?Could you explain it another way? (chỉ dùng khi không hiểu ý, không phải nghe kém)
Root cause chưa chắcIt looks like the old endpoint is still being used.Obviously, it's the old endpoint. (quá chắc và dễ gây khó chịu)

09C / Daily Meeting Interaction — phản xạ theo vai

Hội thoại ngắn cho DemDet / VS Code, AI Coding Agent, PR reviews, SonarQube, Snyk, Azure, incident, PMO và lãnh đạo. Mỗi lượt nói có nút nghe riêng. Luyện cách trả lời, hỏi tiếp và chốt action.

01 — ListenNghe tình huống và hiểu vấn đề
02 — RespondTrả lời bằng câu ngắn
03 — ClarifyHỏi rõ điều chưa chắc
04 — Follow upChốt test, owner hoặc next step
DemDet example — useful meeting pattern

“That could help. But developers would still need to switch to the new window to approve permissions, right?”

Ghi nhận ý tưởng → nêu giới hạn thực tế → hỏi xác nhận. Không đánh đồng việc mở window với việc tự động chấp thuận chạy scripts.
Your reply
32 scenarios
01

DemDet · Open a new VS Code window

Optional parameter, nhưng vẫn cần chuyển cửa sổ để approve permissions.

Developer
DeveloperDemDet suggested adding an optional parameter to open a new VS Code window.
YouThat could help. But developers would still need to switch to the new window to approve permissions, right?That could help. They still need to switch windows, right?That could help. Would developers still need to switch to the new window to approve permissions?
DeveloperYes, and then allow the agent to run the scripts.
YouOkay. Maybe we can test both options and get feedback from the team.Let’s test both options and ask the team.I suggest we test both options and collect feedback before making it the default.
Tip: Avoid promising a fully automatic flow when user approval is still needed.
02

Clarify the user action

Làm rõ bước nào tự động và bước nào cần người xác nhận.

Developer
DeveloperThe agent can open the workspace automatically.
YouDoes it also run the scripts, or does the user need to approve them?Does it run the scripts, or do users approve them?Which steps are automated, and which still require user approval?
DeveloperThe user still needs to approve the commands.
YouGot it. We should make that clear in the setup guide.Okay. Let’s add that to the guide.Let’s document that manual approval step clearly in the setup instructions.
Tip: Separate opening a window from granting permission to execute commands.
03

Feedback on the PR review skill

Chia sẻ feedback chưa chắc đã là root cause.

Tech Lead
LeadHave we received feedback from the EDI team?
YouYes, we got feedback on the PR review skill. We’re still checking the root cause.Yes, we got feedback. We’re checking the cause.Yes. We received feedback about the PR review skill, but the root cause is not confirmed yet.
LeadWhat will you do next?
YouI’ll reproduce the issue with them and compare the output.I’ll test it again with the team.I’ll work with the team to reproduce the issue and compare the expected and actual output.
Tip: Say what is confirmed and what remains under investigation.
04

Agent output needs more context

Nói về context mà không khẳng định AI luôn chính xác.

Manager
ManagerWhy is the agent giving different answers?
YouI think it’s missing some project context. We can add examples and run the test again.It may need more context. Let’s add examples and test again.The output may be affected by missing project context. I recommend improving the input and rerunning the evaluation.
ManagerWill that solve it?
YouIt should help, but we still need to validate the result.It may help. We need to test it.It may improve consistency, but we need evidence before we confirm the fix.
Tip: Use may / likely / need to validate instead of guaranteeing outcomes.
05

AI cost versus productivity

Tập trung outcome thay vì chỉ nói tốc độ.

PMO
PMOAre the agents saving us time?
YouSome teams report time savings. We should also check rework and quality.Some teams save time. Let’s also check quality.We have early positive feedback, but we should measure time saved alongside rework and quality.
PMOWhat metric would you start with?
YouTime per story and the number of review cycles.Time per story and review cycles.I would start with delivery time per story and the number of review iterations.
Tip: Focus on measurable value, not only tool usage.
06

One unresolved comment on the PR

Dùng on the PR khi nói comment / review.

Developer
DeveloperCan I merge this pull request now?
YouThere’s still one unresolved comment on the PR. Could you check it first?One comment is still open. Can you check it?There is one unresolved review comment on the PR. Could you address it before merging?
DeveloperI’ll update it now.
YouPerfect. Let me know when it’s ready for another look.Great. Let me know when it’s ready.Thanks. Please tag me when the update is ready for review.
Tip: on the PR = review activity; in the PR = code or content.
07

Coverage is below the expected level

Không đánh đồng % coverage với chất lượng tổng thể.

Developer
DeveloperThe coverage is only 45%. Is that a blocker?
YouIt depends on the branch policy and the required checks. Let’s confirm those first.It depends on the policy. Let’s check it.We should verify whether the coverage status is required on this target branch.
DeveloperThe status is marked as optional.
YouThen it may not block the merge, but we should still review the risk.It may not block the PR. We should still check the risk.An optional status may not block merging, but we still need to assess the testing gap.
Tip: Required versus optional depends on actual branch policy configuration.
08

SonarQube dashboard has missing metrics

Status ngắn khi project chưa được monitor đầy đủ.

PMO
PMOWhy is this project missing from the dashboard?
YouIt may not be in the monitoring list yet. I’ll check the mapping first.It may be missing from the list. I’ll check.I’ll verify whether the project is included in the tracking inventory and whether recent metrics are available.
PMOCan we have an update tomorrow?
YouYes. I can share what we find, even if the fix isn’t ready yet.Yes. I’ll share an update tomorrow.Yes. I’ll provide a status update tomorrow and highlight any remaining dependencies.
Tip: Promise a status update rather than an unverified fix ETA.
09

New Snyk vulnerability

Nói severity, exposure, fix, owner.

Tech Lead
LeadSnyk found a new high-severity issue.
YouThanks for flagging it. Do we know whether the affected package is used at runtime?Thanks. Is that package used at runtime?Thanks for flagging this. Can we confirm the runtime exposure and the available remediation?
LeadWe need to check the dependency path.
YouOkay. Let’s review the path and agree on an owner.Let’s check it and assign an owner.Let’s validate the dependency path, assess the impact, and agree on the owner and target date.
Tip: Severity alone does not establish exploitability or impact.
10

Vulnerability aging follow-up

Làm rõ trách nhiệm và thời hạn.

PMO
PMOSeveral vulnerabilities have been open for a long time.
YouI can help group them by severity and age. Then we can agree on priorities.I’ll group them by severity and age.I can prepare a severity-and-aging view so that we can agree on priorities and owners.
PMOShould every project fix them this week?
YouNot necessarily. We should check the risk and available fixes first.Not all of them. Let’s check the risk first.I would prioritize based on exposure, business impact, and feasible remediation rather than applying one deadline to every finding.
Tip: Avoid an arbitrary universal SLA without scope and risk.
11

Pipeline failed after a change

Khởi đầu bằng evidence thay vì phỏng đoán.

Developer
DeveloperThe pipeline failed again after the merge.
YouWhat changed since the last successful run? Can you share the failing step?What changed? Can you share the failed step?Could you share the failing task and identify what changed since the last successful pipeline run?
DeveloperWe updated the service connection.
YouLet’s check the identity and permissions first.Let’s check permissions first.I suggest we verify the service connection identity and its permissions before changing the pipeline.
Tip: Ask for one concrete log or diff before recommending changes.
12

Release branch and target environment

Giải thích control ở trigger và branch rule.

Developer
DeveloperWhy do we need a strict release branch rule if the pipeline already lets us choose the environment?
YouThat’s a fair point. The environment choice and the release branch rule control different things.Good point. They control different things.The environment selector controls the deployment target, while branch governance controls which code is eligible to be released.
DeveloperDo we need both?
YouMaybe. Let’s confirm the release risk and approval process first.Let’s check the release risk first.Let’s compare the controls against our release risk and approval requirements before deciding.
Tip: Recognize valid question; distinguish release source and deployment destination.
13

Who can approve production?

Cần biết role/permission và separation of duties.

Approver
ApproverI can see the pipeline, but I cannot approve the production stage.
YouLet’s check the environment approval settings and your permissions.Let’s check your approval access.I’ll verify the environment approval configuration and whether your account is included in the authorized approver group.
ApproverDo I need admin rights?
YouNot necessarily. We should grant only the access needed to approve.No admin rights unless they’re needed.We should follow least privilege and grant only the permissions required for the approval action.
Tip: Approving should not imply broad administrative access.
14

Choose rollout versus rollback

Giải thích risk trước khi chốt.

Developer
DeveloperThe new version looks stable. Can we deploy it to production?
YouMaybe. Have we tested the rollback path and the main user flow?Have we tested rollback and the main flow?Before production, could we confirm the rollback test and the key acceptance checks?
DeveloperRollback is not tested yet.
YouThen I’d prefer to test it first. We can review the result today.Let’s test rollback first.I recommend completing the rollback validation before we approve the release.
Tip: Move from assumption to explicit release evidence.
15

Request complete relevant logs

Xin logs kèm timestamp và yêu cầu che dữ liệu nhạy cảm.

Developer
DeveloperWe cannot reproduce the error locally.
YouCould you also share the relevant logs and timestamps so we can investigate further?Can you share the logs and times?Could you share the relevant application logs, timestamps, and correlation IDs, with any secrets removed?
DeveloperI’ll export them from Application Insights.
YouThanks. Please include the failing request if possible.Thanks. Please include the failed request.Thanks. If available, please include the failing request and its correlation ID.
Tip: Avoid asking for raw credentials, tokens, or unrelated user data.
16

Incident update: confirmed versus likely

Không khẳng định root cause khi còn điều tra.

Manager
ManagerDo we know why the pricing endpoint failed?
YouWe confirmed the connection errors, but we haven’t confirmed the root cause yet.We saw connection errors. We don’t know the cause yet.The connection failures are confirmed; however, the root cause remains under investigation.
ManagerWhat are you checking?
YouWe’re checking the runtime configuration and DNS resolution.We’re checking the config and DNS.We’re validating the effective runtime configuration and DNS resolution at the time of failure.
Tip: Separate confirmed facts, likely causes, and unknowns.
17

Connection string updated but errors continue

Khi deployment/restart có trạng thái không rõ.

Developer
DeveloperWe corrected the connection string, but the error came back after deployment.
YouLet’s check which configuration the new process actually loaded.Let’s check the config it loaded.I suggest we validate the effective configuration loaded by the new process and the DNS response for new connections.
DeveloperCould the retry policy restore the old endpoint?
YouNormally it retries the configured endpoint; it doesn’t change the connection string.It retries requests, not connection strings.The retry policy can prolong failures, but it does not normally replace the configured connection string.
Tip: Do not attribute stale configuration to retry logic without proof.
18

In the meantime / for the time being

Trong lúc chờ vs. giải pháp tạm thời.

Developer
DeveloperThe network team is still checking the DNS record.
YouIn the meantime, we can review the application logs.While we wait, let’s check the logs.While the DNS investigation continues, we can review the application logs and timestamps.
DeveloperShould we move to the new endpoint now?
YouFor the time being, let’s keep the current configuration.For now, let’s keep it as it is.For the time being, I recommend keeping the current configuration until we have validation evidence.
Tip: In the meantime = parallel action; for the time being = temporary state.
19

App Service configuration and Key Vault

Phân biệt nơi lưu config và refresh runtime.

Architect
ArchitectThe secret changed in Key Vault. Will the application pick it up immediately?
YouNot always. We should check how the app reads and refreshes the value.Not always. Let’s check the refresh behavior.It depends on the configuration integration and refresh behavior. Let’s verify how the effective value is loaded.
ArchitectSo the code may need to change?
YouPossibly. It depends on whether we use App Service settings or a config provider.Possibly. It depends on the setup.Possibly. We need to review whether the application reads App Service settings, Key Vault references, or Azure App Configuration.
Tip: Do not promise instant refresh without checking the integration.
20

Application Gateway and DNS mapping

Làm rõ record trỏ đâu và có nhiều hostname.

Developer
DeveloperCan DEV and UAT use the same Application Gateway IP?
YouThey can, if the listeners and routing rules are configured correctly.Yes, if the gateway rules are correct.They can share the frontend IP when the appropriate host-based listeners and routing rules are configured.
DeveloperDo we need separate DNS records?
YouYes, each hostname still needs the right DNS mapping.Yes, each hostname needs DNS.Each hostname still needs a DNS record that resolves to the intended frontend endpoint.
Tip: A shared IP does not remove hostname-specific DNS and routing needs.
21

AKS pod running but queue growing

Tránh nói running = healthy.

Developer
DeveloperThe pod is running, so Kubernetes looks healthy.
YouRunning is a good sign. But is the pod Ready and processing messages?It’s running. Is it Ready and working?Running is one signal. Could we check readiness, queue age, and actual message processing?
DeveloperThe queue is still growing.
YouThen we should check worker logs and dependencies next.Let’s check the worker logs next.Let’s review worker concurrency, dependencies, and logs before adding more replicas.
Tip: Distinguish process state from service health.
22

Temporary VM and cleanup

Giữ môi trường ngắn hạn và dọn sau test.

Developer
DeveloperCan we spin up a test VM for today?
YouYes, but let’s set a clear owner and remove it after testing.Yes. Let’s delete it after the test.A short-lived VM is reasonable, provided that we define ownership and remove it after the test window.
DeveloperWe only need it for the afternoon.
YouPerfect. Let’s keep the setup simple.Great. Keep it simple.That works. Let’s avoid unnecessary configuration for a short-lived test resource.
Tip: spin up = create/start; tear down = remove.
23

Quick status with business impact

Update cho sếp ngắn và không quá chi tiết.

GM
GMHow are things going with the rollout?
YouOverall, we’re on track. One team still needs help with setup, but production isn’t affected.It’s going well. One team needs setup help.The rollout is progressing as planned. One setup dependency remains, with no confirmed production impact.
GMDo you need anything from me?
YouNot at the moment. I’ll let you know if we need a decision.Not now. I’ll keep you posted.Nothing right now. I’ll escalate only if a decision or additional support is needed.
Tip: Start with impact; avoid turning a casual status check into a deep technical review.
24

Prioritizing two projects

Xin ưu tiên thay vì âm thầm làm mọi thứ.

Manager
ManagerCan you review the two projects this afternoon?
YouI can review both, but which one should I focus on first?I can. Which one is more urgent?I can cover both. Could you confirm which project has the higher priority?
ManagerThe production blocker comes first.
YouUnderstood. I’ll take that first and come back to the other one.Okay. I’ll start with that.Understood. I’ll prioritize the production blocker, then follow up on the second review.
Tip: Clarify trade-offs instead of giving an unrealistic commitment.
25

Agree on actions and owners

Chốt action, owner, date.

PMO
PMOWe have three open points. Can we close the meeting?
YouBefore we close, can we confirm the owner and target date for each one?Can we confirm who does what, and when?Before closing, I suggest we confirm the action owner, expected date, and any dependencies for each point.
PMOGood point. Let’s go through them.
YouGreat. I’ll capture them in the follow-up.Okay. I’ll write them down.Thanks. I’ll record the agreed actions and share the follow-up after the meeting.
Tip: A decision is not complete without ownership and follow-up.
26

Disagree without sounding defensive

Phản biện dựa trên impact.

Leader
LeaderWe should roll this out to every project next week.
YouI see the benefit. My concern is that we haven’t tested enough project types yet.I see the idea. We need more tests first.I support the direction, but I recommend validating it on a broader set of projects before a full rollout.
LeaderWhat would you propose?
YouMaybe start with two more projects and review the results.Let’s try two more projects first.I suggest a short pilot with two additional projects and clear success criteria.
Tip: Acknowledge the objective, name one risk, propose a test.
27

Shorter daily meeting

Cách đề xuất giảm thời lượng họp.

PMO
PMOThe daily meeting is scheduled for one hour.
YouDo you think one hour is a bit long for a daily meeting? Maybe 30 minutes would be enough.One hour feels long. Could we try 30 minutes?Since we meet every day, could we try a 30-minute slot and extend it only when needed?
PMOThat sounds reasonable.
YouPerfect. We can keep deeper topics for a separate call.Great. We can discuss details later.Great. We can move longer technical discussions to focused follow-up sessions.
Tip: State the suggested change and the benefit; no need for a long apology.
28

Asked for an ETA you do not have

Không đoán thời gian.

Leader
LeaderWhen will the issue be fixed?
YouI don’t have a reliable ETA yet. I’ll share an update after the next check.I don’t know yet. I’ll update you after the check.The fix ETA is not confirmed. I’ll report the next investigation result at the agreed checkpoint.
LeaderIs production affected?
YouWe haven’t confirmed a production impact so far.No confirmed production impact so far.We have no confirmed production impact at this stage; monitoring is continuing.
Tip: No confirmed impact is not the same as proof of no impact.
29

Ask someone to repeat

Dễ nói khi nghe nhanh hoặc âm thanh kém.

Colleague
ColleagueWe’ll switch the endpoint after the regional freeze next Thursday.
YouSorry, I missed the date. Could you say it again?Sorry, which date?Sorry, I missed the timing. Could you repeat the date a little more slowly?
ColleagueNext Thursday, the twenty-ninth.
YouThanks. I’ll put that in the chat so we’re aligned.Thanks. I’ll add it to the chat.Thanks. I’ll confirm the date in the channel so everyone has the same information.
Tip: Ask for the specific part you missed instead of a broad re-explanation.
30

Volunteer to test a solution

Give it a try, without overpromising.

Developer
DeveloperWe haven’t tested the new command on Windows yet.
YouI can give it a try on my machine. I’ll share the result.I can try it and let you know.I can run a local test and share the result, including any limitations.
DeveloperThat would help. Thanks.
YouNo problem. I’ll check the permissions before running it.Sure. I’ll check permissions first.Happy to help. I’ll verify the required permissions before executing the command.
Tip: Give it a try = thử; do not present a test as a confirmed solution.
31

Small talk before daily meeting

Câu ngắn nói chuyện tự nhiên về thời tiết và giao thông.

Colleague
ColleagueThe rain was heavy this morning.
YouYes, traffic was quite bad. Did you have a long trip to the office?Yes, a lot of traffic. How was your trip in?Yes, the roads were busy. Was your journey to the office affected?
ColleagueA bit, but I got here on time.
YouGood. Shall we get started?Great. Shall we start?Glad you made it on time. Shall we begin the meeting?
Tip: Social bridge → response → one question → transition to meeting.
32

Catch up over coffee after a review

Chuyển nhẹ giữa đời sống và công việc.

Colleague
ColleagueThat was a long review. Coffee?
YouSure. I could use a short break. Have you tried the place downstairs?Sure. Let’s get coffee.Sounds good. A short break would be nice. Have you tried the café downstairs?
ColleagueNot yet. Is it good?
YouThe coffee is strong, and it’s usually quiet in the afternoon.Yes, good coffee and not too busy.I like it. The coffee is strong, and it tends to be quiet in the afternoon.
Tip: One small personal detail makes a casual conversation more natural.
Practice in 5 minutes: Listen to the colleague → cover your answer → say one short reply → reveal and compare → change one detail from your real project. Khi nói nhanh, ưu tiên bản Simpler.

09D / Spoken English for Meetings — nói tự nhiên nhưng vẫn rõ ý

Những mẫu thường nghe từ đồng nghiệp Mỹ, Pháp và quốc tế: I’m like / I was like, it’s supposed to, I’m supposed to, the fact is that, the thing is, I suppose và các cách phản hồi ngắn trong meeting.

Mental model
Casual reaction → Clear observation → Confirmed fact → Next action. Khi kể chuyện, bạn có thể dùng “I was like...”. Khi báo cáo incident, hãy ưu tiên “I noticed...”, “It looks like...” hoặc “We confirmed...” tùy mức độ bằng chứng.

01. I’m like...

Casual story

Tôi kiểu như... (mô tả phản ứng, rất thân mật)

What you may hear
I’m like, why is the same error happening again?
Clearer in technical meetings
My first thought is that we should check the logs.

Tự nhiên khi kể chuyện / small talk; đừng lạm dụng trong báo cáo kỹ thuật.

02. I was like...

Past reaction

Lúc đó tôi kiểu như... (kể lại phản ứng trước đây)

What you may hear
I was like, wait, why did the agent open another window?
Clearer in technical meetings
I was surprised that the agent opened another window.

Không đồng nghĩa chính xác với “I said”; có thể kể suy nghĩ chưa nói ra.

03. It’s supposed to...

Expected behavior

Lẽ ra hệ thống phải... (hành vi mong đợi)

What you may hear
It’s supposed to open the folder in a new window.
Clearer in technical meetings
The expected behavior is to open the folder in a new window.

“It’s supposed” thường chưa trọn ý; cần “to + verb” hoặc “to be + ...”.

04. I’m supposed to...

Responsibility

Tôi được giao/có trách nhiệm/phải làm theo kế hoạch

What you may hear
I’m supposed to review the PR before lunch.
Clearer in technical meetings
I’m responsible for reviewing the PR before lunch.

Không có nghĩa “I suppose” = tôi đoán.

05. We’re supposed to...

Process

Nhóm được yêu cầu hoặc dự kiến làm gì

What you may hear
We’re supposed to get approval before the deployment.
Clearer in technical meetings
The agreed process requires approval before deployment.

Nên kiểm tra yêu cầu thực tế thay vì tự suy đoán quy định.

06. I suppose...

Tentative view

Tôi nghĩ là... / có lẽ (không chắc)

What you may hear
I suppose we can test it with one project first.
Clearer in technical meetings
I think a small pilot would be a reasonable first step.

“I suppose” hơi dè dặt, đôi khi nghe thiếu nhiệt tình.

07. The fact is that...

Confirmed fact

Thực tế là... (nhấn mạnh một sự thật đã xác minh)

What you may hear
The fact is that the PR still has one unresolved comment.
Clearer in technical meetings
The PR still has one unresolved comment.

Chỉ dùng “fact” khi có bằng chứng; câu ngắn hơn thường tốt hơn.

08. The thing is...

Gentle caveat

Vấn đề là... / điều cần lưu ý là... (tự nhiên)

What you may hear
The thing is, developers still have to approve the permissions.
Clearer in technical meetings
One limitation is that developers must still approve permissions.

Cách nói mềm hơn “The fact is that”.

09. The point is...

Main point

Ý chính là...

What you may hear
The point is, opening a new window doesn’t remove the permission step.
Clearer in technical meetings
The main point is that the permission step still remains.

Hữu ích khi đưa cuộc họp về trọng tâm.

10. The problem is...

Blocker

Vấn đề là...

What you may hear
The problem is, we don’t have the full logs yet.
Clearer in technical meetings
The main blocker is missing log evidence.

Có thể nghe quá tiêu cực nếu mở đầu mọi câu bằng “problem”.

11. It’s just that...

Gentle limitation

Chỉ là... (giải thích một giới hạn hoặc sự dè dặt)

What you may hear
I can give it a try. It’s just that I need access first.
Clearer in technical meetings
I can test it once the required access is granted.

Dùng được khi trò chuyện; tránh thêm quá nhiều từ đệm.

12. What I mean is...

Rephrase

Ý tôi là... (nói lại cho rõ)

What you may hear
What I mean is, the PR is merged but the deployment hasn’t started.
Clearer in technical meetings
To clarify, the PR is merged but deployment is still pending.

Rất hữu ích khi người khác hiểu nhầm.

13. I mean...

Spoken filler

Ý là... / tôi muốn nói là...

What you may hear
I mean, we can try it, but let’s check the impact first.
Clearer in technical meetings
We can try it after checking the impact.

Tự nhiên khi nói; hạn chế lặp liên tục.

14. Kind of / sort of

Softening

Kiểu như / hơi hơi (làm nhẹ mức độ)

What you may hear
It’s kind of slow when the agent starts.
Clearer in technical meetings
The agent is a bit slow to start.

Trong báo cáo, nói rõ số liệu thay vì quá mơ hồ.

15. A bit...

Soft feedback

Hơi... (giảm mức độ, lịch sự)

What you may hear
The setup is a bit confusing for new developers.
Clearer in technical meetings
The setup could be clearer for new developers.

Tốt để phản hồi mang tính xây dựng.

16. It looks like...

Early findings

Có vẻ như... (dựa trên dấu hiệu, chưa xác nhận)

What you may hear
It looks like the old connection string is still in use.
Clearer in technical meetings
The evidence suggests the old connection string may still be in use.

Đừng thay bằng “Obviously” nếu chưa xác minh.

17. As far as I know...

Knowledge boundary

Theo những gì tôi biết...

What you may hear
As far as I know, this policy applies to the main branch.
Clearer in technical meetings
Based on the current configuration, this policy appears to apply to main.

Nêu rõ giới hạn hiểu biết, tránh khẳng định chắc chắn.

18. From what I’ve seen...

Observed evidence

Theo những gì tôi quan sát được...

What you may hear
From what I’ve seen, the new window doesn’t fix the approval step.
Clearer in technical meetings
The tests so far show that approval is still required.

Rất hữu ích khi có kết quả kiểm thử nhưng chưa kết luận rộng.

19. It turns out...

New discovery

Hóa ra là... (khi phát hiện điều bất ngờ)

What you may hear
It turns out the issue was caused by an expired token.
Clearer in technical meetings
We confirmed that an expired token caused the issue.

Chỉ dùng khi đã biết kết quả, không phải phỏng đoán.

20. That’s what I was thinking.

Agree

Đúng ý tôi đang nghĩ.

What you may hear
That’s what I was thinking. We should test one repo first.
Clearer in technical meetings
I agree. A one-repository pilot makes sense.

Dùng khi đồng ý tự nhiên, không cần quá trang trọng.

21. I was wondering if...

Polite request

Tôi muốn hỏi liệu... (nhờ vả mềm)

What you may hear
I was wondering if you could share the full error message.
Clearer in technical meetings
Could you share the full error message and timestamp?

Tự nhiên nhưng dài; câu “Could you...” thường trực tiếp hơn.

22. What if we...?

Proposal

Hay là chúng ta thử...

What you may hear
What if we test both options with the DemDet team?
Clearer in technical meetings
I suggest comparing both options with the DemDet team.

Rất phù hợp brainstorming, nên kèm bước tiếp theo.

23. At this point...

Current status

Ở thời điểm hiện tại...

What you may hear
At this point, we still don’t know the root cause.
Clearer in technical meetings
The root cause remains unconfirmed.

Tránh diễn giải như đã tìm được nguyên nhân.

24. In the meantime...

During the wait

Trong lúc chờ, làm một việc khác

What you may hear
We’re waiting for approval. In the meantime, let’s check the logs.
Clearer in technical meetings
While approval is pending, we can review the logs.

Không đồng nghĩa với “for the time being”.

25. For the time being...

Temporary state

Tạm thời giữ trạng thái/giải pháp

What you may hear
For the time being, let’s keep the previous version.
Clearer in technical meetings
I recommend keeping the previous version until validation is complete.

“For now” là lựa chọn ngắn, tự nhiên trong daily meeting.

26. I can give it a try.

Offer help

Tôi có thể thử xem sao.

What you may hear
I can give it a try, then share the results.
Clearer in technical meetings
I can run an initial test and report back.

Không hứa chắc sẽ giải quyết xong.

27. I’d say...

Estimation

Theo tôi thì... / tôi ước lượng...

What you may hear
I’d say we need another day to test this properly.
Clearer in technical meetings
My estimate is one additional day of testing.

Dùng khi đánh giá, không thay số liệu/bằng chứng.

28. We might as well...

Practical suggestion

Nhân tiện thì chúng ta cũng có thể...

What you may hear
We might as well check the pipeline while we’re here.
Clearer in technical meetings
Since the pipeline is already open, we can verify its policy settings.

Sắc thái tùy tiện; không dùng cho quyết định rủi ro cao.

Role-play: Respond, clarify and follow up

Luyện với leader, developer, PMO và manager. Chọn một kiểu trả lời, ẩn lời của bạn, nghe lời đồng nghiệp rồi nói lại trước khi mở đáp án.

Your answer style

01. Unexpected VS Code window

expected
DEVELOPERWe added a parameter to open a new VS Code window.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...That could help. But developers still need to approve permissions in that window, right? That may help. They still need to approve permissions, right? The option is useful, but permission approval still requires a manual step. Is that correct?
DEVELOPERExactly. How should we test it?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Let’s try both options with DemDet and get their feedback. Let’s test both options first. I suggest comparing both options with DemDet and collecting usability feedback.

02. What is supposed to happen?

expected
DEVELOPERThe script is stuck after it opens VS Code.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...It’s supposed to ask for permission. Do we see the prompt in the new window? It should ask for permission. Is the prompt there? The expected behavior is a permission prompt. Can we confirm whether that prompt appears in the new window?
DEVELOPERI can check that now.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Great. I’ll look at the agent logs in the meantime. Okay. I’ll check the logs. Thanks. I’ll review the agent logs while you validate the prompt.

03. Assigned to review PR

expected
LEADWho is reviewing the pull request today?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...I’m supposed to review it this afternoon. I’ll post my comments in the PR. I’ll review it this afternoon. I’m assigned to review the PR this afternoon and will document any findings there.
LEADCan you check the unresolved comment too?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Sure. I’ll check that first. Yes, I’ll check it. Yes. I’ll prioritize the outstanding review comment.

04. Casual story about agent behavior

story
COLLEAGUEDid you see what happened in yesterday’s agent demo?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Yes! I was like, why did it create another window? Yes. I was surprised by the new window. Yes. The unexpected window was the first thing I noticed.
COLLEAGUEIt surprised everyone.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Exactly. But the permission step still needs work. Yes, but approval is still manual. Agreed. We should focus next on making that approval step clear.

05. Use facts with manager

clarity
MANAGERCan we say the root cause is confirmed?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...The fact is that the errors stopped after redeployment, but we still don’t know why. The errors stopped, but the cause is not confirmed. We confirmed recovery after redeployment; however, the underlying cause remains unverified.
MANAGERWhat do you need to check?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...The effective configuration and the deployment logs. The configuration and logs. We need to compare the effective configuration with deployment events and application logs.

06. Present a concern gently

clarity
ARCHITECTI think opening another window solves the whole issue.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...The thing is, developers still need to switch windows and approve the scripts. They still need to approve the scripts. One remaining limitation is the required manual approval in the newly opened window.
ARCHITECTGood point. What would you suggest?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Let’s make that step visible in the workflow. Let’s show the approval step clearly. I suggest adding a clear instruction and testing whether users notice it.

07. Explain the main point

clarity
PMOSo the new setting fixes the developer setup, right?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Not completely. The point is, the new window is optional, but permission approval stays manual. Not fully. Approval is still manual. The option changes window behavior but does not remove the authorization step.
PMOCan you put that in the notes?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Yes, I’ll make it clear in the follow-up. Yes, I’ll add it. Yes. I’ll document that distinction in the meeting notes.

08. Ask for complete logs

request
DEVELOPERI can only see the final error message.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Could you share the relevant logs and timestamps so we can check what happened before it failed? Could you send the logs and time of the error? Could you share the relevant logs, timestamps and correlation ID, with secrets removed?
DEVELOPERSure, I’ll export them.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Thanks. I’ll compare them with the last successful run. Thanks. I’ll compare the logs. Thank you. I’ll compare them with a known-good execution.

09. Clarify without blaming

clarity
DEVELOPERI thought the PR had already passed all checks.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...What I mean is, the build passed, but the SonarQube policy may still be optional. The build passed. The policy may be optional. To clarify, a successful build does not prove that the SonarQube status is required by branch policy.
DEVELOPEROkay. Where do we check?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Let’s look at the policy on the target branch. Let’s check the branch policy. Let’s verify the required status checks on the target branch.

10. Offer a small experiment

proposal
MANAGERCan you help us check whether this works for other teams?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...I can give it a try with one project first, then share the results. I can test one project first. I can run a small pilot with one project and report the findings.
MANAGERHow soon can we know?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...I’ll confirm the test scope and give you an update. I’ll confirm the plan. I’ll confirm scope and timing once the project team is available.

11. Discuss Snyk finding

uncertainty
PMOIs this Snyk vulnerability affecting production?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...As far as I know, we haven’t confirmed exposure yet. We need to check how the package is used. We don’t know yet. We need to check usage. Production exposure remains unverified. We need to review package usage and execution paths.
PMOWho can help?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...The project Tech Lead can review it with me. I’ll check with the Tech Lead. I’ll coordinate the analysis with the project Tech Lead.

12. Unexpected test result

story
DEVELOPERThe new change passed the local tests.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...It turns out the integration test still fails in CI. Let’s compare the environments. CI still fails. Let’s compare the setups. Local tests passed, but CI integration tests still fail. We should compare environment differences.
DEVELOPERCould it be the credentials?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Maybe. Let’s check the service connection first. Maybe. Let’s check access first. That’s one possibility. Let’s verify service connection permissions.

13. Waiting for approval

time
LEADSecurity hasn’t approved the new agent version yet.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...For now, let’s keep the current version. In the meantime, we can review the test cases. Keep the current version. We can check tests while we wait. I recommend retaining the approved version until security review is complete, while continuing test preparation.
LEADSounds reasonable.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Great. I’ll share the test summary tomorrow. Okay. I’ll send the summary. I’ll circulate the test summary tomorrow.

14. Every time vs one-time error

frequency
DEVELOPERThe pipeline failed after yesterday’s change.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Does it fail every time we run it, or was it a one-time issue? Does it always fail, or only once? Is the failure reproducible on every run, or was it isolated?
DEVELOPERIt only failed once.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Okay. Let’s rerun it and compare the logs. Let’s run it again. Let’s reproduce it and compare the pipeline logs.

15. Any questions before closing

frequency
MANAGERWe’re nearly out of time.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Does anyone have any questions before we close? Any questions before we finish? Before we close, does anyone have any remaining questions or concerns?
MANAGERNo questions from my side.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Perfect. I’ll share the actions in Teams. Okay. I’ll post the actions. I’ll share the decisions, owners and next steps in Teams.

16. Discuss recurring issue

frequency
DEVELOPERThe same error showed up again this morning.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Does it happen every day, or only after deployment? Is it daily or after deployment? Can we identify whether the issue occurs daily or is linked to deployments?
DEVELOPERUsually after deployment.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...That helps. Let’s compare the deployment timestamps. Let’s check deployment times. Let’s correlate the errors with deployment timestamps.

17. Manager asks for the actual status

clarity
MANAGERAre we ready to roll out the skill to all projects?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...The fact is that we’ve only tested two projects. I’d prefer a wider pilot first. We tested only two projects. Let’s test more. The current evidence covers only two projects. I recommend expanding the pilot before organization-wide rollout.
MANAGERWhat should we measure?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...Output quality, rework, and time saved. Quality, rework, and time saved. I suggest measuring quality, rework rates and engineering time saved.

18. Soft disagreement with leader

proposal
LEADERMaybe we should require the new workflow for all teams tomorrow.
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...I see the benefit. I’m just a bit concerned about teams that haven’t tested it yet. That may be too soon for some teams. I support the direction, but I see a rollout risk for teams without validation.
LEADERWhat do you suggest?
YOUTự nói câu trả lời của bạn trước...What if we start with the pilot teams and expand gradually? Let’s start with pilot teams. I recommend a phased rollout, starting with teams that have completed validation.
Ghi nhớ: “I’m like / I was like” không sai; chỉ là quá thân mật nếu dùng liên tục trong formal review. “The fact is that” cũng không sai, nhưng phải đi với sự thật đã kiểm chứng. Trong daily standup, ngắn và chính xác thường tốt hơn: “We know what failed, but not why yet.”

10 / TA communication · AI agents · SonarQube · Snyk

Cách diễn đạt rõ, ngắn, có bằng chứng, không vô tình khẳng định quá mức. Các sơ đồ giúp nhớ luồng xử lý.

AI Coding Agent — Feedback → Improvement loop

Daily update
“I got feedback from the teams.”
Not confirmed
“We’re still checking the root cause.”
Follow-up
“We’ll rerun the test cases and compare.”

PR checks — SonarQube, Coverage, Snyk & branch policy

Chủ đềÝ chính khi báo PMO / managerEnglish to say
CoverageTỉ lệ code được test chạy qua, không đồng nghĩa code đúng hoặc an toàn.“Coverage is only one signal. We need the other checks too.”
Quality GateĐiều kiện chất lượng SonarQube; cần xem cấu hình cụ thể.“Let’s check the actual Quality Gate conditions.”
Branch policyQuy định điều kiện nào required cho branch cụ thể.“Is this status required on the target branch?”
SnykPhát hiện rủi ro dependency/code; cần đánh giá tác động và cách sửa.“We should review severity, exposure, and available fixes.”
OwnerChốt Tech Lead / team phụ trách, deadline.“Can we agree on the owner and a target date?”

Incident update — timeline có mức độ chắc chắn

CONFIRMED

What we know

“The configuration was updated at 18:15. Errors were still observed afterward.”

LIKELY

What we think

“The runtime may have continued using the old SQL endpoint.”

UNKNOWN

What to check

“We haven’t confirmed why it was still used after deployment.”

Ví dụ dựa trên ghi chú FleetCard trong tài liệu gốc; không biến các giả thuyết trước đây thành kết luận. Với incident mới, thay ngày/giờ, scope và evidence theo log thật.

Copy-ready chunks — câu ngắn dùng ngay trong Teams và khi ăn trưa

Đọc chậm theo nhóm từ. Bấm biểu tượng ⧉ để copy câu phù hợp với tình huống.

Ý địnhEnglish phraseNghĩa tiếng ViệtContext
Warm openerHow’s your week going? Tuần này thế nào rồi?Lunch
Warm openerHave you tried this place before? Bạn thử quán này bao giờ chưa?Lunch
Soft follow-upReally? What was it like? Vậy à? Trải nghiệm thế nào?Lunch
SharingI haven’t tried that yet. Mình chưa thử cái đó.Lunch
SharingI usually go for Vietnamese coffee. Mình thường chọn cà phê Việt.Lunch
Light workThings are going well so far. Mọi chuyện khá ổn đến giờ.Lunch
Light workWe’re getting useful feedback from the teams. Bọn mình đang nhận được feedback hữu ích.Lunch
BoundaryWe can go through the details at work. Mình trao đổi chi tiết lúc làm việc nhé.Lunch
CloseThanks, that was a nice lunch. Cảm ơn, bữa trưa vui đấy.Lunch
FeedbackI got some feedback from the EDI team. Mình nhận feedback từ EDI.Agent
StatusWe’re still looking into the root cause. Đang điều tra nguyên nhân.Agent
QualityWe need more real-world test cases. Cần thêm case thực tế.Agent
SuggestionLet’s try it with one team first. Thử với một team trước.Agent
RiskWe haven’t confirmed the cause yet. Chưa xác nhận nguyên nhân.Incident
RiskThe logs suggest a connection issue. Log gợi ý lỗi kết nối.Incident
EvidenceBased on the logs we checked... Dựa trên log đã kiểm tra...Incident
PolicyIs this a required check for the target branch? Đây có phải check bắt buộc của branch đích?Security
PolicyCan we confirm the owner and target date? Chốt owner và ngày mục tiêu nhé?Security
ClarifySorry, I missed the last part. Xin lỗi, mình không nghe kịp đoạn cuối.Meeting
ClarifySo the change is required before deployment, right? Vậy thay đổi này cần trước deploy, đúng không?Meeting
CloseIf there’s nothing else, let’s wrap up. Nếu hết chủ đề, mình kết thúc nhé.Meeting
CourseThe main takeaway is... Ý quan trọng nhất là...Course
CourseIn other words, it means... Nói cách khác, nghĩa là...Course
CourseThat doesn’t necessarily mean... Điều đó không nhất thiết có nghĩa...Course

Manager vs PMO vs developer — cùng vấn đề, 3 độ sâu

General Manager

Impact + direction

“We found a security gap in the PR process. We’re checking the risk and the fix.”
PMO

Scope + owner + deadline

“Three projects need follow-up. Can we agree on the owners and priorities?”
Developer / Architect

Evidence + details + next test

“The coverage status is optional on this PR. Let’s check the target-branch policy and status context.”

11 / Say this, not that

Không phải câu “tránh” nào cũng sai ngữ pháp. Một số quá mạnh, quá riêng tư, hoặc dễ tạo hiểu nhầm trong giao tiếp quốc tế.

Lunch & everyday small talk 10 tình huống

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Where do you want to eat?

Nên nói

Any place you’d like to try today?

Câu đầu vẫn đúng; câu gợi ý mềm và dễ mở chủ đề.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

You French people always eat bread.

Nên nói

Do you miss any food from France?

Không quy chụp theo quốc tịch.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Why are you still living in Vietnam?

Nên nói

What do you enjoy about living here?

Why are you still... nghe như chất vấn.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Your salary must be very high.

Nên nói

How do you find the cost of living here?

Tránh hỏi thu nhập riêng tư.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Do you have any children? How old? Where do they study?

Nên nói

Any plans for the weekend?

Đừng hỏi sâu gia đình nếu người kia chưa chủ động chia sẻ.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

You must drink with us!

Nên nói

No pressure — there are non-alcoholic drinks too.

Không gây áp lực uống bia/rượu.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

I want to discuss a lot of company problems over lunch.

Nên nói

We can go through the details at work.

Giữ không khí thư giãn, đặc biệt với GM.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Tell me what you think about your team’s performance.

Nên nói

How have things been going lately?

Không biến trò chuyện thành đánh giá nhân sự.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

I am grateful for all your support.

Nên nói

Thanks, I really appreciate it.

Bản gốc đúng nhưng hơi trang trọng trong bữa café.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Give me the bill.

Nên nói

Could we get the bill, please?

Cách nói lịch sự phổ biến tại nhà hàng.

Daily / Teams / manager 10 tình huống

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

I made a meeting with the EDI team.

Nên nói

I had a meeting with the EDI team.

Have a meeting tự nhiên hơn make a meeting.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

I received feedbacks from teams.

Nên nói

I got some feedback from the teams.

Feedback thường không đếm được.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

The agent hallucinated because of the prompt.

Nên nói

It may be related to the instructions or missing context. We’re checking.

Không khẳng định root cause khi chưa xác minh.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

You are wrong.

Nên nói

I see it a bit differently. Can we check one example?

Phản biện ý tưởng thay vì công kích cá nhân.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

This meeting is too long.

Nên nói

Do you think one hour is a bit too long for a daily meeting?

Giữ ý, giảm độ áp đặt.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Repeat!

Nên nói

Sorry, could you say that again?

Lịch sự và dễ nói.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

You need to speak English.

Nên nói

Could we switch to English for this part?

Xin chuyển ngôn ngữ đúng phạm vi.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

All teams must use this tomorrow.

Nên nói

Maybe we can test it with one more team before wider rollout.

Dùng khi cần kiểm chứng trước khi áp dụng rộng.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

No issue, we can cancel the meeting now.

Nên nói

If there are no topics, we can skip today’s meeting.

Skip nếu chưa bắt đầu, wrap up nếu đang họp.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

I finished it completely.

Nên nói

The change is done. We’re still validating it.

Phân biệt hoàn thành thay đổi và xác nhận tác động.

IT / risk / troubleshooting 10 tình huống

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Production is broken.

Nên nói

We’re seeing an issue in production. The impact is still being checked.

Không nói toàn bộ production lỗi nếu scope chưa rõ.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Snyk says critical, so we’re hacked.

Nên nói

Snyk flagged a critical issue. We need to check exposure and impact.

Severity không chứng minh đã bị khai thác.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Coverage passed, so code quality is good.

Nên nói

The coverage check passed. We still need to review the other quality checks.

Coverage chỉ là một chỉ số.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Sonar Quality Gate is required, so coverage status is required.

Nên nói

Let’s verify whether the coverage status is required in the branch policy.

Hai trạng thái/controls có thể độc lập.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

The retry policy caused a wrong SQL endpoint.

Nên nói

The retry policy prolonged failures; why the old endpoint was used is still unconfirmed.

Phân biệt tác động retry với root cause.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

No errors means the fix is fully verified.

Nên nói

We saw no matching errors, but normal-traffic validation is still limited.

Nêu điều kiện/giới hạn bằng chứng.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Just open all ports to make it work.

Nên nói

Let’s allow only the required traffic and test again.

Tránh giải pháp làm rộng quyền truy cập.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Developers must access the production Key Vault.

Nên nói

Let’s first clarify what access they need for local development.

Least privilege, môi trường và secrets khác nhau.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

The PR is safe because the build is green.

Nên nói

The build passed. We still need to review security and required branch checks.

Build green không thay thế security review.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

The appsettings value updates every time Key Vault changes.

Nên nói

Let’s check how the app loads secrets and whether refresh is configured.

Refresh behavior tùy integration và cấu hình.

Learning / describing concepts 8 tình huống

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

We will make an experiment.

Nên nói

Let’s run a small experiment.

Run an experiment là collocation.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Good planning facilitates the work.

Nên nói

Good planning makes the work easier.

Câu gốc đúng nhưng bản này nói tự nhiên hơn.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

It is a very realism goal.

Nên nói

It’s a realistic goal.

Realistic (adjective), không phải realism.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

We will shutdown gracefully the application.

Nên nói

We’ll shut down the application gracefully.

Shut down là động từ; shutdown là danh từ/tính từ.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

The error is imminent.

Nên nói

A failure may be imminent.

Imminent thường đi với event sắp diễn ra, không phải tình trạng lỗi hiện hữu.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Let me give a name for it.

Nên nói

Let me give it a name.

Give something a name.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

Please update more precision.

Nên nói

Please make it more precise.

Precise = tính từ; precision = danh từ.

Nên tránh / chỉ dùng đúng ngữ cảnh

We work intensive on it.

Nên nói

We’re working intensively on it.

Intensively là trạng từ; khi nói dùng “focus on” cũng dễ.

New · Audio, adverbs, PR & Present Perfect 14 tình huống

Audio / clarity · Better avoid in this context

Can you explain it another way? [when audio is unclear]

Better to say

Sorry, could you say that again?

Nếu nghe không rõ → xin lặp lại; nếu đã nghe nhưng chưa hiểu ý → ask for an example / explanation.

Audio / clarity · Better avoid in this context

Your accent is too strong.

Better to say

Could you speak a bit slower? I missed the last part.

Tập trung nhu cầu nghe, không nhận xét accent.

PR review · Better avoid in this context

You have a comment in the PR.

Better to say

You have one unresolved comment on the PR.

On the PR tự nhiên với review comments; “in” hợp nội dung code.

Certainty · Better avoid in this context

Obviously, the developer made a mistake.

Better to say

The logs show an error. Let’s check what caused it.

Tránh khẳng định lỗi của người khác.

Uncertainty · Better avoid in this context

Apparently, this is definitely the root cause.

Better to say

It looks like a possible cause, but we need to verify it.

Apparently / definitely mâu thuẫn nếu chưa có bằng chứng.

Manager · Better avoid in this context

I want all teams to do it my way.

Better to say

I’d suggest starting with one team and checking the results.

Đề xuất thử nghiệm thay vì áp đặt.

Perfect tense · Better avoid in this context

I have sent the file yesterday.

Better to say

I sent the file yesterday.

Yesterday = mốc quá khứ đã xong → Past Simple.

Perfect tense · Better avoid in this context

I’m living here since 2021.

Better to say

I’ve lived here since 2021.

Dùng Present Perfect với since khi sống liên tục đến hiện tại.

Meeting · Better avoid in this context

I do not understand your English.

Better to say

Sorry, could you say the last part one more time?

Nêu vấn đề cụ thể bạn cần giúp.

Leadership · Better avoid in this context

We are perfectly safe.

Better to say

We haven’t seen any new errors in the logs we checked.

Giới hạn theo phạm vi evidence.

Social · Better avoid in this context

How much money do you earn in Vietnam?

Better to say

What do you enjoy most about living here?

Không dò hỏi thông tin nhạy cảm vào bữa trưa.

Meeting · Better avoid in this context

Absolutely, I will finish it tomorrow. [not sure]

Better to say

I’ll try to finish it tomorrow and update you if anything changes.

Không dùng absolutely như cam kết nếu chưa chắc.

Work update · Better avoid in this context

It will eventually fail.

Better to say

There’s a risk of failure if the dependency stays unavailable.

Eventually không đồng nghĩa maybe; làm rõ điều kiện.

Social · Better avoid in this context

You have been here five years, so you should know everything.

Better to say

You’ve been here a while. Is there a place you’d recommend?

Tránh tạo áp lực với người khác.

12 / Listen smarter: Pluralsight & Google Skills

Đọc đúng ý giảng viên và nhận biết các cụm từ “báo trước” điều gì sắp được giải thích.

Graceful shutdown — từ vựng gắn với một tiến trình

What the instructor says

“A shutdown is imminent. The application should stop accepting new requests and allow in-flight work to finish where possible before it exits.”

How you can say it

“The service will stop soon. We should stop new work, finish current requests if possible, and then exit safely.”

Quy trình và thời gian graceful shutdown phụ thuộc vào runtime/platform (Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps, Kubernetes, v.v.). Đây là sơ đồ học từ, không phải cam kết ứng dụng luôn xử lý hết request.

Course listening patterns — nghe cụm này, dự đoán ý tiếp theo

Instructor saysNgười nói sắp làm gì?Câu đơn giản để ghi chú
Let’s walk through...Đi từng bướcLet’s go step by step.
It’s worth noting...Nêu cảnh báo quan trọngOne important point is...
In other words...Diễn giải lạiSimply put...
Here’s the catch...Nêu giới hạn / điều kiệnBut there is one issue...
Under the hood...Giải thích cơ chế bên trongInternally, it works like this...
That tends to...Mô tả xu hướng, không tuyệt đốiIt often...
The trade-off is...So sánh lợi ích và đánh đổiWe gain X but lose Y.
It pays off later...Lợi ích ở giai đoạn sauIt helps us later.
Let’s zoom in...Đi sâu vào một phầnLet’s look closer.
Let's step back...Nhìn bức tranh lớnLet’s look at the big picture.

5-sentence method: tóm tắt mọi video kỹ thuật

  1. The main idea is... — Nêu khái niệm.
  2. The key difference is... — Phân biệt với khái niệm gần giống.
  3. A simple example is... — Lấy ví dụ Azure/GCP.
  4. One thing to watch out for is... — Nêu giới hạn/rủi ro.
  5. I can use this when... — Liên hệ công việc của mình.
Example — Cloud networking

The main idea is that routes decide where traffic goes. The key difference is that firewall rules control what traffic is allowed. For example, a VM can be reachable but still have an unsafe firewall rule. We should watch out for overly broad access. I can use this when troubleshooting network issues.

13 / Vocabulary bank — học theo “chunks”

Lựa chọn từ theo bối cảnh. Nhìn câu giảng viên dùng, rồi đọc câu đơn giản để tự nói lại.

Signposting in courses (12 cụm)

Let’s walk through
đi qua từng bước

“Let’s walk through the setup.”

Nói đơn giản: Let’s check it step by step.

Bear in mind
hãy nhớ / lưu ý

“Bear in mind that this is a shared network.”

Nói đơn giản: Remember that this network is shared.

It’s worth noting
đáng chú ý là

“It’s worth noting that retries are not infinite.”

Nói đơn giản: One important point is that retries are limited.

In the first place
ngay từ đầu / vốn dĩ

“Why did we create this VM in the first place?”

Nói đơn giản: Why did we need this VM originally?

Under the hood
cơ chế bên trong

“Under the hood, the SDK retries failed calls.”

Nói đơn giản: Internally, the SDK retries failed calls.

Out of the box
có sẵn ngay khi dùng

“Logging works out of the box.”

Nói đơn giản: Logging works with the default setup.

Here’s the catch
điểm cần lưu ý

“Here’s the catch: the service can still time out.”

Nói đơn giản: But there is one important limit.

In other words
nói cách khác

“In other words, this controls where traffic goes.”

Nói đơn giản: Simply put, it controls the route.

That being said
tuy vậy / dù vậy

“That being said, there is still some risk.”

Nói đơn giản: But there is still some risk.

At a high level
ở mức tổng quan

“At a high level, the system has three parts.”

Nói đơn giản: The system has three main parts.

Drill down
đi sâu vào chi tiết

“We’ll drill down into the network settings.”

Nói đơn giản: We’ll look at the details.

Takeaway
ý chính cần nhớ

“The key takeaway is to limit access.”

Nói đơn giản: The main point is to limit access.

Cloud lifecycle & reliability (20 cụm)

Imminent
sắp xảy ra / cận kề

“A shutdown is imminent.”

Nói đơn giản: The service will shut down very soon.

Gracefully shut down
dừng một cách có kiểm soát

“The app should shut down gracefully.”

Nói đơn giản: Stop accepting new work and finish what you can.

Abruptly terminate
dừng đột ngột

“The process may terminate abruptly.”

Nói đơn giản: The process may stop suddenly.

In-flight requests
request đang xử lý

“Let in-flight requests complete.”

Nói đơn giản: Let the current requests finish.

Drain connections
ngừng nhận mới và xử lý dần kết nối cũ

“The server starts draining connections.”

Nói đơn giản: It stops taking new connections and closes existing ones safely.

Shutdown grace period
thời gian cho phép thoát êm

“The process has a shutdown grace period.”

Nói đơn giản: There is limited time to finish the work.

Cold start
khởi tạo khi chưa có instance sẵn

“Cold starts can add latency.”

Nói đơn giản: The first request may be slower.

Scale to zero
scale xuống 0 instance

“The service can scale to zero.”

Nói đơn giản: It can stop all running instances when idle.

Spin up
khởi tạo và chạy nhanh

“Spin up a test VM.”

Nói đơn giản: Create and start a test VM.

Tear down
gỡ/xóa tài nguyên

“Tear down the test environment.”

Nói đơn giản: Remove the test resources.

Short-lived
tồn tại ngắn hạn

“It is a short-lived VM.”

Nói đơn giản: We only need it for a short time.

Cutover
chuyển sang hệ thống mới

“We’ll perform the cutover tonight.”

Nói đơn giản: We’ll switch traffic to the new system.

Roll back
quay lại phiên bản trước

“We may need to roll back.”

Nói đơn giản: We may need to restore the previous version.

Failover
chuyển sang thành phần dự phòng

“Failover happens when the primary fails.”

Nói đơn giản: The backup takes over.

Fallback
phương án/hành vi thay thế

“Use a fallback if the API is unavailable.”

Nói đơn giản: Use another safe option when the API fails.

Take effect
bắt đầu có hiệu lực

“The new config takes effect after restart.”

Nói đơn giản: The new settings apply after restart.

Idempotent
lặp lại mà không gây thêm hiệu ứng mong muốn

“The operation should be idempotent.”

Nói đơn giản: Running it twice should not create duplicate results.

Exponential backoff
tăng thời gian chờ giữa các lần retry

“Use exponential backoff for retries.”

Nói đơn giản: Wait longer after each failure.

Throttling
giới hạn tốc độ request

“The service is throttling requests.”

Nói đơn giản: It is limiting how fast requests come in.

Blast radius
phạm vi ảnh hưởng

“We want to reduce the blast radius.”

Nói đơn giản: We want fewer systems to be affected.

Network / security / infrastructure (13 cụm)

Ingress
luồng vào

“Ingress rules control incoming traffic.”

Nói đơn giản: Rules for traffic coming in.

Egress
luồng ra

“Egress rules control outgoing traffic.”

Nói đơn giản: Rules for traffic going out.

Reachable
có thể kết nối tới

“The VM is reachable.”

Nói đơn giản: We can reach the VM over the network.

Too restrictive
quá chặt

“The rule is too restrictive.”

Nói đơn giản: The rule blocks traffic we need.

Too permissive
quá mở

“The rule is too permissive.”

Nói đơn giản: The rule allows too much traffic.

Mis-scoped
sai phạm vi

“The rule is mis-scoped.”

Nói đơn giản: The rule applies to the wrong resources.

Steer traffic
điều hướng lưu lượng

“Routes steer traffic to the next hop.”

Nói đơn giản: Routes decide where traffic goes next.

Next hop
đích chuyển tiếp tiếp theo

“Check the next hop of this route.”

Nói đơn giản: Check where the packet goes next.

Least privilege
cấp quyền tối thiểu

“Apply least privilege.”

Nói đơn giản: Give only the access that is needed.

Whitelisted / allowlisted
có trong danh sách cho phép

“Is this IP allowlisted?”

Nói đơn giản: Is this IP allowed?

Exposure
mức độ tiếp xúc / khả năng bị tác động

“Check the application’s exposure.”

Nói đơn giản: Check whether this risk can affect the app.

Govern
điều chỉnh/chi phối

“The policy governs the merge process.”

Nói đơn giản: The policy controls the merge process.

Enforce
bắt buộc thực thi

“The policy is enforced on main.”

Nói đơn giản: The policy must pass on main.

Coding agents / QA / DevOps (17 cụm)

Maturity
mức độ hoàn thiện

“The process has reached a higher maturity level.”

Nói đơn giản: The process is more stable and consistent.

Reconciliation
đối chiếu / tìm chênh lệch

“We need to reconcile the project lists.”

Nói đơn giản: We need to compare the two lists.

Onboard
đưa vào hệ thống/quy trình

“We need to onboard more projects to Snyk.”

Nói đơn giản: We need to add those projects to Snyk monitoring.

False positive
cảnh báo dương tính giả

“This finding may be a false positive.”

Nói đơn giản: The tool might have flagged something that isn’t an actual issue.

False negative
bỏ sót vấn đề thật

“A scan can still have false negatives.”

Nói đơn giản: The tool might miss a real issue.

Root cause
nguyên nhân gốc

“The root cause is still unconfirmed.”

Nói đơn giản: We don’t know the real cause yet.

Narrow it down
thu hẹp phạm vi tìm lỗi

“We’re narrowing down the cause.”

Nói đơn giản: We’re checking fewer possible causes now.

Regression
lỗi tái xuất hiện sau thay đổi

“The release introduced a regression.”

Nói đơn giản: Something that worked before is now broken.

Rollout
triển khai ra nhiều nhóm/người dùng

“We’re planning a gradual rollout.”

Nói đơn giản: We’ll enable it for more teams step by step.

Trade-off
đánh đổi

“There is a cost-versus-latency trade-off.”

Nói đơn giản: We can gain speed but pay more.

At scale
khi mở rộng quy mô

“This becomes harder at scale.”

Nói đơn giản: This gets harder with many users.

Guardrail
rào chắn bảo vệ / quy tắc an toàn

“Add guardrails to the agent workflow.”

Nói đơn giản: Add checks to reduce risky behavior.

Deterministic
đầu ra nhất quán theo input/trạng thái xác định

“The step should be deterministic.”

Nói đơn giản: The same input should give the same output under the same conditions.

Telemetry
dữ liệu vận hành để quan sát

“We need telemetry for the agent.”

Nói đơn giản: We need logs and metrics to see how it behaves.

Ownership
trách nhiệm phụ trách

“We need clear ownership.”

Nói đơn giản: We need to know who is responsible.

Threshold
ngưỡng

“The coverage threshold is 80%.”

Nói đơn giản: Coverage must meet the chosen limit.

Blocking check
kiểm tra có thể chặn merge

“This is a blocking check.”

Nói đơn giản: The merge cannot proceed unless the check passes.

Conversation & everyday expressions (16 cụm)

Fair enough
hợp lý / nghe cũng được

“Fair enough. Let’s try that.”

Nói đơn giản: Okay, that makes sense.

No worries
không sao đâu

“No worries. We can do it tomorrow.”

Nói đơn giản: That’s fine.

By the way
nhân tiện

“By the way, did you try that café?”

Nói đơn giản: One more thing...

Speaking of
nhắc đến mới nhớ

“Speaking of coffee, there’s a new place nearby.”

Nói đơn giản: Since we mentioned coffee...

I see what you mean
mình hiểu ý bạn

“I see what you mean, but I have one concern.”

Nói đơn giản: I understand your point.

A bit
một chút / hơi

“The meeting is a bit long.”

Nói đơn giản: The meeting is slightly long.

That makes sense
nghe hợp lý

“That makes sense.”

Nói đơn giản: I understand why.

Sounds good
nghe ổn đấy

“Sounds good. Let’s do that.”

Nói đơn giản: Okay, I agree.

Give it a try
thử xem sao

“Let’s give it a try.”

Nói đơn giản: Let’s test it.

Catch up
trò chuyện cập nhật nhau

“Let’s catch up over coffee.”

Nói đơn giản: Let’s chat over coffee.

Go with
chọn phương án

“Let’s go with this option.”

Nói đơn giản: Let’s choose this option.

Pay off
mang lại kết quả / trả hết nợ

“The early planning paid off.”

Nói đơn giản: The early planning helped us later.

Look into
điều tra / tìm hiểu

“I’ll look into the issue.”

Nói đơn giản: I’ll check it.

Get back to
phản hồi sau

“I’ll get back to you tomorrow.”

Nói đơn giản: I’ll reply tomorrow.

Wrap up
kết thúc gọn

“Let’s wrap up here.”

Nói đơn giản: Let’s finish here.

Last but not least
cuối cùng nhưng không kém quan trọng

“Last but not least, let’s confirm the owner.”

Nói đơn giản: One last thing: who owns this?

15 / A realistic 4-week speaking plan

15–20 phút/ngày. Ưu tiên phản xạ, phát âm dễ hiểu và ghi nhớ cụm thường gặp trong các cuộc họp tuần tới.

Week 1 · Social

Ăn trưa, cà phê, small talk, chuyển chủ đề.

Week 2 · Meetings

Daily agent, feedback, blockers, manager, PMO.

Week 3 · Tech

SonarQube, Snyk, CI/CD, incident, prepositions.

Week 4 · Courses

Google / Pluralsight, shutdown, cloud lifecycle, summary.
